sentences.text:
Dated :
03-02-2026 Shri Deependra Singh Khuswah- learned Additional Advocate General for appellant- State.

Shri R. K. Sharma- learned Senior Counsel and Shri Vijay Dutt Sharma- learned Counsel as amicus curiae.
This Reference has been made under Section 318 of CrPC by the Special Judge (POCSO Act),
Gwalior in SC Case No. 186 of 2022, whereby accused has been convicted under Sections 449,
376(AB), 506 Part I of IPC and Section 5(m) read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
This Court, vide order dated 16-07-2024, appointed Shri R.K.Sharma, learned Senior Counsel, as well as Shri Vijay Dutt Sharma, learned Counsel, as Amicus Curiae in the matter to assist this Court.
Although accused- Kalyan Raikwar was present before this Court on 16-07-2024, he has not been noticed regarding the proceedings.
Therefore, proceeding further, it is apposite that accused- Kalyan Raikwar be noticed, so that he may represent through his Counsel and advance arguments on the question as referred in the Reference.
Let notice be issued to accused- Kalyan Raikwar and be served through Jail Superintendent, Central Jail, Gwalior, as he is suffering confinement in Central Jail, Gwalior.

A copy of Reference and judgment be sent along-with notice, and it 2 CRRF-1-2024 would be the duty of Jail Superintendent, Central Jail, Gwalior, to serve accused- Kalyan Raikwar and submit a report in this regard.
Needful to be done within four weeks.
On that day, Jail Superintendent, Central Jail, Gwalior, is directed to cause appearance of accused- Kalyan Raikwar.
